Caerlee Mill Bike Campus work continues before 2027 opening

3rd October
Planning and development
Scottish Borders
By Chris Faulds Audience and Content Editor

Instaread

Work is continuing on the Caerlee Mill Bike Campus, ahead of a planned opening in 2027.

The mountain bike innovation centre in Innerleithen, built on the former Caerlee Mill site, is moving steadily towards completion.

More:Borders town’s first new homes in a decade up for grabs

A spokesperson for South of Scotland Enterprise (SOSE) said: "Construction works continue to progress well at Caerlee Mill Bike Campus.

"In the next few months, the project’s contractor Morrison Construction will ensure the building is wind and watertight ahead of the winter.

More:Greggs to close Borders factory as nationwide restructure puts 740 jobs at risk

"Internal works have begun with the internal spaces now really taking shape."

The site will host the IMBA Europe Summit in September 2027, a key event for the European mountain biking community.

More:'We are going nowhere' - Borders woman left with anxiety after repeated power cuts

SOSE said it is currently promoting the remaining spaces to potential tenants and welcomes enquiries for both short and long-term lets.

Enquiries can be sent to MTB@sose.scot.
